definition: Maximal consecutive round identifiers with logged restore_best_model_and_optimizer. All scored records delimit runs; all eight admissions serve as boundaries. Missing4331splits the observed run and is never filled. Capture/gap boundaries are labelled, not treated as observed admissions.
selection: Every rejected decision belongs to exactly one plotted run, in source order; no selection by utility, duration or gain. Admitted decisions are retained as boundary events rather than plotted rejections.
scope: Counts of recorded adaptive adapter decisions, not independent trials, elapsed training time, neural-writer/ranking-map learning or program-search progress. Exact installed source/adapter/pool/input-closure/normalization binding remains unqualified.
